# BoFu, Baby

> Bottom-of-funnel content engines for B2B companies: pages written for buyers who are already shopping, built to rank on Google and to get named by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Claude when those buyers ask who to use. Published prices: the BoFu Map is $1,500 (credited in full); the 90-Day BoFu Build is $22,500 over 90 days ($9,000, $7,500, $6,000); Defend & Expand is $4,500/mo after; Monitor is $1,500/mo.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.bofubaby.com/): What BoFu, Baby does, how AI citation (AEO) is measured, and the five-part engine
- [Pricing](https://www.bofubaby.com/pricing/): Step-down fee, what ships each month, Defend & Expand, guarantee, add-ons, terms and FAQ
- [The BoFu Map](https://www.bofubaby.com/bofu-map/): $1,500, five business days, the complete bottom-of-funnel keyword set with an AI citation baseline
- [Services](https://www.bofubaby.com/services/): Published offers. Free 15-minute call, the BoFu Map ($1,500), the 90-Day BoFu Build ($22,500), Defend & Expand ($4,500/mo), Monitor ($1,500/mo). Full schedule on Pricing.
- [About](https://www.bofubaby.com/about/): Colin Dowling writes the notes. Podcast: Modern Business Life (https://modernbusiness.life/)
- [Resources](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/)
- [Contact](https://www.bofubaby.com/contact/): Book a free 15-minute call
- [Free 15-minute keyword plan](https://www.bofubaby.com/15minutes5xtraffic/): Five BOFU keywords, a rank plan for each, AI citation gap

## Posts
<!-- posts:start -->
- [What you leave the free 15-minute call with](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/what-the-free-15-minute-call-includes/): On a free 15-minute call you get five high-intent searches, where you are missing from them, and whether the AIs are naming you or a competitor. You keep it either way.
- [Ranking and getting cited are two different jobs](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/ranking-and-getting-cited/): BoFu, Baby measures AI citation separately from rank: ten buyer-intent questions, five runs each, across four platforms. That is 200 checks a month.
- [Bottom-of-funnel search is a list you can finish](https://www.bofubaby.com/blog/bottom-of-funnel-search-is-finite/): Bottom-of-funnel searches in a B2B category are finite: alternatives, versus, pricing, best-for, switching and integrations. The BoFu Map counts that list.
